messages.subject: download of development version fails.
parts:
At the end of the download process, I receive the following error. 

Reloading installed SpaDES
Error in get(Info[i, 1], envir = env) : 
  lazy-load database '/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.3/Resources/library/reproducible/R/reproducible.rdb' is corrupt
In addition: Warning message:
In get(Info[i, 1], envir = env) : internal error -3 in R_decompress1

As a result, SpaDES can not now be loaded.

What should I do?

messages.author: 94bb4033d27320d5
messages.subject: Re: download of development version fails.
parts: I removed the reproducible.rbd a tried again. Did not change the outcome.

messages.author: 71df1ea0682dcc02
messages.subject: Re: download of development version fails.
parts: Usually, this occurs when you are trying to install a package that is already in use, and can be resolved by restarting R and reinstalling the package.
